## 5-Minute Reply

The instant a lead arrives (website form POST or Calendly booking), this workflow:
1. Logs the lead to a Google Sheet "Leads" tab
2. Sends a warm, human-sounding reply from Gmail within seconds
3. Posts a Slack alert to #leads so a human jumps in

Order matters: log, then reply, then alert. Every external call has Continue On Fail, so a CRM hiccup never blocks the reply.

Before first run: configure credentials + env vars (see README) and set this workflow as its own Error Workflow.

### SWAP POINT 1: Lead sources

One webhook, one URL, both sources POST to it:
- Website form: name, email, message, source
- Calendly: name, email, event_time

Responds 200 immediately (Respond: Immediately) so the form never waits.

Swap: point ANY form/booking tool at this URL (Typeform, Tally, Jotform, Cal.com, Acuity). If its payload uses different field names, adjust only the next node (Normalize Lead).

### Normalize Lead

Detects the source (event_time present = Calendly, otherwise form), extracts the first name, stamps received_at, and writes the email subject + body.

Want different email copy? Edit the two templates inside this node. Nothing else needs to change.

### SWAP POINT 2: CRM

Demo = Google Sheets "Leads" tab.

Swap this node for HubSpot (Create Contact) or Pipedrive (Create Person / Lead). Map the same 4 fields: name, email, source, received_at.

Continue On Fail is ON: if the CRM is down, the lead STILL gets their reply and Slack still fires.

### SWAP POINT 3: Email provider

Demo = Gmail.

Swap for Outlook / SMTP / SendGrid. Keep the three expressions pointing at Normalize Lead: email, email_subject, email_body. The copy itself lives in the Normalize Lead node.

### SWAP POINT 4: Team alert

Demo = Slack (#leads channel, set via SLACK_LEADS_CHANNEL env var).

Swap for Telegram: replace with a Telegram node, chatId = your chat, same text. Or Discord, MS Teams, SMS. Anything that pings a human fast.

### Failure alert

If the whole run errors out, this fires a Slack alert to the same #leads channel (a missed lead is exactly what that channel watches for).

IMPORTANT: only works if you set this workflow as its own Error Workflow (Settings > Error Workflow > 5-Minute Reply).

Prefer Telegram? Swap this node the same way as SWAP POINT 4.
